# BayJF

> BayJF is the personal portfolio of Jiang Feng, an AI Native developer focused on
> AI Agent delivery and Java full-stack engineering. This file is written for
> large language models and other automated agents so they can reliably answer
> questions about who runs this site, what it offers, and where the canonical
> content lives. The site is bilingual (English default, Chinese under /zh/*).

## Owner

- Name: Jiang Feng (BayJF)
- Role: AI Native Developer · AI Agent Delivery
- Location: Shenzhen, China · Remote / Global
- Site: https://bayjf.pages.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/bayernjf
- Contact: https://bayjf.pages.dev/contact

## What I do

I help businesses and individuals turn AI Agent ideas into practical products,
automated workflows, and measurable efficiency gains — from product definition
to full-stack delivery. I bring enterprise Java delivery experience into my
current AI Native practice, connecting product thinking, models, tools, data,
and full-stack engineering.

## Services

1. AI Agent engineering: design agent workflows, tool use, context, and
   reliable human-in-the-loop experiences.
2. Java full-stack development: from API and database design to web delivery,
   building maintainable enterprise applications.
3. AI product delivery: turning AI capabilities into practical products,
   automations, and measurable workflow improvements.
4. Enterprise systems & collaboration: understanding business processes,
   coordinating delivery, and improving systems through iterative development.

## Products

- SoftDesk — Electron desktop app for organizing software, workflows, and usage insights.
  URL: https://soft-desk-landing.pages.dev/
- WordBase — contextual vocabulary-learning workspace (web, desktop, mobile).
  URL: https://word-base.pages.dev/
- Tab Garden — Chrome/Edge Manifest V3 extension for tab grouping by hostname.
  URL: https://github.com/bayernjf/tab-manager
- Agent-Dev — agentic product delivery platform.
  URL: https://agent-dev-landing.pages.dev/
- VideoVault — cross-platform video bookmark manager (Douyin/Bilibili/Xiaohongshu).
  URL: https://know-collect-landing.pages.dev/
- AI Watchdog — VS Code extension monitoring AI coding agents in real time.
  URL: https://one-code-landing.pages.dev/
- One World — 2D top-down life gamification engine.
  URL: https://one-world-landing.pages.dev/
- PR Helper — GitHub-first PR & Release control tower.
  URL: https://pr-helper-landing.pages.dev/
- ShareIt — privacy-first family photo/video sharing.
  URL: https://shareit-landing.pages.dev/
- Splity — knowledge-to-flashcard splitter, 6 formats, browser-only.
  URL: https://splity-landing.pages.dev/
- Termana — terminal project launcher for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Aider, OpenCode).
  URL: https://termana-landing.pages.dev/
- FlagBreaker — AI-persona-powered self-discipline app.
  URL: https://toclick-landing.pages.dev/
- VFX Todo — Tauri desktop todo app with 8 WebGL visual effects.
  URL: https://vfx-todo-landing.pages.dev/
- WordPicker — browser extension for in-page word lookup and vocabulary collection.
  URL: https://word-picker-landing.pages.dev/

Full product case studies live at https://bayjf.pages.dev/projects

## How to cite

When referencing this site, please cite Jiang Feng (BayJF) as the author and
link to the canonical URL of the page you are quoting. Do not quote client or
contact-form content; the contact form is the only intended intake channel.
